honing_confound: Barrage Mode skill damage scales with Specialization (gear honing). Tier standing reflects T4 burst output during Barrage Mode at peak Specialization.

delivery.evidence: Artillerist deploys a huge cannon/artillery pack. Barrage Enhancement focuses on Barrage Mode skills: Howitzer (artillery shell), Destroy Artillery (concentrated barrage), Flamethrower (cone AoE), Homing Barrage (guided missiles). All heavy ordnance delivery.

footprint.evidence: Artillerist has among the widest AoE footprints in LA. Homing Barrage covers a wide target zone. Howitzer creates significant impact radius. Flamethrower is a wide cone. The largest ground-coverage DPS class in the game.

geo_text: Barrage Enhancement Artillerist deploys heavy ordnance from medium-long range. The class CANNOT MOVE while casting most Barrage Mode skills (stationary turret identity). Barrage Mode activates via Identity Gauge fill — during Barrage Mode, specialized barrage skills become available. Outside Barrage Mode: normal heavy-gun skills. Extreme AoE coverage; lowest mobility in the Gunner archetype.

control.evidence: Artillery impacts create significant knockback and stagger effects. Artillerist has very high Stagger and Destruction output per raid tier lists — valuable for boss phase breaks. CC is a rider but very high in absolute value.

defense.evidence: Heavy armor (artillery pack). Highest HP pool in the Gunner archetype. No mobility-based defense — trades mobility for armor-type tankiness.

economy.resource_verbatim: Firepower Meter (Identity Gauge) + Barrage Meter (specialized within Barrage Mode)
economy.builder_source: All skill usage fills Firepower Meter. At full meter: Z key → enter Barrage Mode. Barrage Mode has its own sub-meter for enhanced barrage skills.
economy.plain_text: BARRAGE MODE ECONOMY: Firepower Meter fills via all skills → Activate Barrage Mode → specialized barrage skills become available (Howitzer, Flamethrower, Destroy Artillery, Homing Barrage). Each barrage skill costs Barrage Meter. BARRAGE ENHANCEMENT IDENTITY: Barrage Mode skills deal significantly increased damage; Barrage Mode timer may be extended. Strategy: efficient Firepower generation → maximize Barrage Mode activation → maximize skill usage within Barrage Mode window.

element.evidence: Cannon fire = Physical damage. Flamethrower = Fire damage. Artillery typically Physical with elemental variants.

movement.evidence: LOWEST MOBILITY IN LA. Artillerist cannot move while casting most skills. Barrage Mode = completely stationary turret. The class is the game's ultimate 'plant and shoot' archetype. No dash skills.

attr.evidence: Medium to long range artillery. Engages from safe distance (30-40m for some skills). No melee requirement.

range.evidence: Artillerist has long effective range for most skills. Homing Barrage can reach across significant distance.

tempo.evidence: Barrage Enhancement is the burst identity: Firepower fill → Barrage Mode activation → burst window with specialized skills.

amp.value: Barrage Mode: enhanced barrage skills with increased damage; Barrage Enhancement identity amplifies within Barrage Mode
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Barrage Enhancement specifically amplifies Barrage Mode skill damage.

proxy.evidence: Homing Barrage launches guided missiles — these are auto-tracking projectiles (quasi-proxy) rather than persistent entities. Not quite proxy mechanics per our taxonomy.

commitment.evidence: Multiple Barrage Mode skills are channeled (hold to fire). Flamethrower is a long channel AoE. Destroy Artillery is a channel barrage sequence. The class is defined by long channels while stationary.

mechanics_notes: 1) Artillerist is LA's FULL MOBILITY TRADE: zero repositioning in exchange for massive AoE damage + stagger + destruction. The most extreme 'plant-and-shoot' design in the corpus. 2) HIGH STAGGER + DESTRUCTION CONTRIBUTION: Artillerist is one of the best raid-utility classes in LA due to consistently topping stagger and destruction charts. This non-damage contribution is not captured in the delivery schema but is a major reason for the class's raid value despite mobility limitations. 3) Barrage Mode as a 'turret transformation' — entering Barrage Mode visually deploys the artillery pack and the Artillerist becomes a fixed artillery emplacement. This is a rare example of a complete gameplay-mode shift with visual transformation in a non-explicit 'transformation' class. 4) Artillerist is the most easily damaged DPS class in LA raids due to zero mobility — the trade-off is explicit and punishing.
stabilization_patch: Barrage Enhancement consistently strong due to Barrage Mode damage ceiling and stagger output. Firepower Enhancement is a secondary choice.
tier_standing_release: A-tier at launch (valued for stagger/destruction utility)
tier_standing_current: A-tier (Manillagames January 2026). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Barrage Mode skill damage at T4 Specialization is competitive in DPS rankings but mobility limitation prevents higher tier in mobile raid content.

honing_confound: Firepower Enhancement provides +20% damage to all skills (when at maximum Firepower level) — this stacks multiplicatively with gear damage stats. Higher honing = higher baseline to multiply against.

delivery.evidence: Firepower Enhancement uses the same skill set as Barrage Enhancement but without the dedicated Barrage Mode emphasis. Normal skills gain damage from Firepower Gauge level.

footprint.evidence: Same wide-AoE footprint as Barrage Enhancement from the normal skill set (Homing Barrage, Howitzer, flamethrower are available outside Barrage Mode in normal skill set).

geo_text: Firepower Enhancement Artillerist maintains Firepower Gauge at maximum level for a flat damage bonus to ALL skills. The identity doesn't require entering Barrage Mode as the primary mechanic — instead, it's about keeping the Firepower Gauge filled and using any skill at peak power.

control.evidence: Same as Barrage Enhancement — high Stagger/Destruction output from artillery.

economy.resource_verbatim: Firepower Gauge (3 levels — higher level = more damage)
economy.builder_source: All skills fill Firepower Gauge. Gauge has multiple levels (1/2/3). FIREPOWER ENHANCEMENT IDENTITY: at max gauge level (Level 3), all skills deal additional damage (+20% per training knowledge).
economy.plain_text: GAUGE-LEVEL ECONOMY: Firepower Gauge fills via skills through 3 levels. Higher level = more damage on all skills. Firepower Enhancement identity: maximize Firepower level maintenance. The economy is 'always be firing skills to maintain max Firepower level.' No distinct burst mode like Barrage Enhancement — all output is at Firepower Level 3 when maintained.

movement.evidence: Same zero-mobility profile. Same stationary casting.

tempo.evidence: Firepower Enhancement is the sustained identity: maintain Level 3 Firepower Gauge for constant +20% damage. No burst mode window.

amp.value: Level 3 Firepower: all skills +20% damage (Firepower Enhancement identity)
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Specific percentage not confirmed from live sources.

commitment.evidence: Same channel/stationary commitment as Barrage Enhancement for major skills.

mechanics_notes: 1) Firepower Enhancement is the Artillerist's 'simpler but more consistent' identity — the sustained +20% damage at Level 3 Firepower is always active rather than gated behind a Barrage Mode burst window. More beginner-friendly. 2) Same pattern as other LA simplification identities (FI Wardancer, Reflux Sorceress, Energy Overflow Soulfist). The 'easier sustained vs complex burst' pattern appears in the Artillerist archetype as well. 3) Firepower Enhancement Artillerist's stagger/destruction contribution is similar to Barrage Enhancement because the skill pool overlaps significantly. The utility output (raid contribution beyond personal DPS) is one of the more important aspects of both Artillerist identities. 4) LA design observation: Artillerist is the only class where BOTH identities are widely viable in endgame content with different meta positions (Barrage = higher ceiling; Firepower = more consistent). Most class pairs have one clear 'main' and one 'alternative.'
stabilization_patch: Firepower Enhancement has been the more accessible Artillerist identity from launch; Barrage Enhancement favored in high-performance raid optimization.
tier_standing_release: A-tier at launch (tied with Barrage Enhancement)
tier_standing_current: A-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: same multiplicative stack concerns as Barrage Enhancement.
